title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Improving income, food security and health status of extreme poor and most vulnerable individuals by strengthening food and health system in West Darfur programme will work in West Darfur State, Republic of Sudan. It aims to contribute to Concern Sudan’s Food Systems for Food Security and Health, Nutrition and WASH thematic programmes, and the goal of the grant is to contribute to improving thewell-being of the target population in West Darfur through increased food and income security, and equitable access to quality health and nutrition services. The programme will support over 647,450 people living in extreme and poor households with a particular focus on pregnant and lactating mothers, and children under five, subsistence farmers, pastoralists and Internally Displaced people.. This will be done through increasing access to finance and market for productive assets, improved access to quality seeds for staple crops, improved capacity of targeted health facilities to provide quality, responsive and sustainable health services in target localities and improved technical capacity to ensure quality of care in maternal, new-born, child health and nutrition services.OBJECTIVES: Improved food security of vulnerable HHs through enhanced and adapted production & management servicesOUTCOMES: The food and nutrition security of the targeted population in West Darfur improved, through better adaption of shocks and stresses, increased income and equitable access to quality integrated health and nutrition services
